Name: Ksoul - Tteok (Korean style dessert)
Author: eunj920
Description:
[size=5][b]< Install the mode >[/b][/size]
Decompressed the downloaded zip file in the Stardew Valley mods folder.
Then you'll have "[JA] Tteok" folder.

How to make Tteok : [url=https://danharu0920.tistory.com/108]https://danharu0920.tistory.com/108[/url]

[size=5][b]< The mod includes >[/b][/size]
12 artisan goods
Baek-seolgi (Snow White Tteok) ※ "Baek" means the number 100.
Garae-tteok (White Tteok)
Gyeongdan (Sweet Rice Balls)
Hwajeon (Flower pan-fried Tteok)
Injeolmi (Coated glutinous Tteok)
Jeolpyeon (Patterned Tteok)
Kkultteok (Honey-filled Tteok)
Pat-siru-tteok (Steamed Tteok with Red bean)
Songpyeon (Half-moon Tteok)
Surichwi-tteok (Wheel patterned Tteok)
Yaksik (Sweet Rice with Nuts and Jujubes)

4 Recipes
Ksoul Soybean Powder
Steamed Glutinous rice Flour
Steamed Rice Flour
Tteoksal (Tteok stamp)
